# Sysbreeze Technologies

> Sysbreeze Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an IT and business solutions company based at Kinfra Techno Industrial Park, Kakkanchery, Calicut, Kerala. The company provides technology services, digital marketing, business solutions, HR solutions, and industry-focused professional training programs.

## Company

Sysbreeze Technologies helps businesses, startups, and professionals with technology, marketing, software, HR, branding, and career-oriented training solutions.

Primary location: Kinfra Techno Industrial Park, Kakkanchery, Calicut, Kerala, India

Website: https://www.sysbreeze.com/
